favourite.heading: Why Indiana can pull away
bullets: Indiana is the better football team by 17.5 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 64% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+17.5 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Northwestern can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 +2.9 to p90 +46.9 for Indiana, so a projection of +25.9 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.

The market disagrees by 4.4 points. The market is not the truth, but a gap that large is more often the model missing information (a suspension, a starter, a scheme change) than the market being wrong.
